vidéoflows uses libVLC (https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc-android),
distributed by VideoLAN as the Maven package org.videolan.android:libvlc-all.

libVLC is free software licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License,
version 2.1 or later (full text in LIBVLC_LICENSE.txt in this folder).
Its source code is available at:
  https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc
  https://code.videolan.org/videolan/vlc-android

vidéoflows links to libVLC as an unmodified, separate library. You can replace
it with your own build by changing the libvlc-all dependency in
app/build.gradle.kts and rebuilding the app.

VLC and the VLC cone are trademarks of VideoLAN. vidéoflows is not affiliated
with or endorsed by VideoLAN.
